results.title: Bluon Energy Ltd
results.description: Bluon Energy Ltd was fined £105,000 for instigating 194,379 unsolicited live direct marketing calls between April 2024 and April 2025 to telephone numbers that had been registered with the Telephone Preference Service (TPS) for more than 28 days.
